description: This source file implements handling routines for JSON serialization and deserialization of Open vSwitch sets (OVS_SET) for various data types such as integers, booleans, reals, strings, and UUIDs. It provides generic functions to convert sets to and from JSON format, managing complex scenarios like optional presence, set verification, and size constraints.

methods.description: Parses a JSON representation of an OVS_SET, identifying whether it's a set or a single value, and invokes a callback to convert each element into internal data structures. Handles errors related to missing objects and size constraints.

methods.description: Converts an internal set of values into a JSON format, creating a JSON array wrapped in a set structure if multiple elements are present, or a single value otherwise. Supports exclusion of internal fields based on naming convention.
